message.content:
方程式 \(x^{2}+2x+3=0\) 的判別式為  

\[
\Delta=b^{2}-4ac=2^{2}-4\cdot1\cdot3=4-12=-8<0
\]

因為 \(\Delta<0\)，此方程式沒有實數根，而是兩個共軛複數根：

\[
x=\frac{-b\pm\sqrt{\Delta}}{2a}
   =\frac{-2\pm\sqrt{-8}}{2}
   =\frac{-2\pm 2i\sqrt{2}}{2}
   =-1\pm i\sqrt{2}
\]

所以解為  
\[
x_1=-1+i\sqrt{2},\qquad x_2=-1-i\sqrt{2}.
\]

The discriminant D = b^2 - 4ac = 4 - 12 = -8. So no real solutions; complex solutions: x = [-b ± sqrt(D)]/(2a) = [-2 ± sqrt(-8)]/2 = [-2 ± 2i*sqrt(2)]/2 = -1 ± i*sqrt(2). So the solutions are x = -1 + i√2 and x = -1 - i√2.
